title: Quietly Adventurous Uruguayan Courgettes Casserole
description: A tender and adventurous vegetarian dish featuring courgettes and tempered chocolate, inspired by Uruguayan cuisine. This casserole is perfect for those looking for a unique and flavorful meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced courgettes and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tempered chocolate pieces and cook until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
